text:
maria: FYI LargeBank wants a 2-week on-prem air-gapped POC. They require USB-delivered artifacts, signed delta updates only, and a patch SLA. Can we confirm feasibility?

devon: Core asks: max bundle <2GB, offline activation, manifest verification without network. Also asked about quantized vs fp16 sizes.

kai: Microbundle plan: core runtime ~750-900MB, model shards separate. q4_0 shards ~25% of fp16. We can sign each file and provide a signed manifest + verification steps.

maria: Do we have a sample manifest for Legal?

kai: Example manifest snippet: `{"components":[{"name":"core.tar.gz","sha256":"<hex>","sig":"core.sig"},{"name":"weights.q4_0.bin","sha256":"<hex>","sig":"weights.sig"}]}`. Verification: `shasum -a256 -c manifest.sha256` then `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify key.pub -signature manifest.sig manifest.json`.

nina: Security: need to confirm signing key custody. If customer requires HSM signing we need a key-exchange and acceptance test. Also must include SBOM (signed), anti-rollback, and an opt-out/no-egress telemetry guarantee. Patch SLA: they asked for 7 days for criticalwe need to confirm.

jord: Delta tooling: we can ship a small patcher (~12MB) with the USB. Deltas for quantized shards typically 20-40%. Offline clients will apply patches locally. Logistics: courier timelines need to be part of contract.

maria: Procurement asked pricing model: POC as T&M, with credit if they commit to 3-month reserved. Also a one-time packaging/signing PS fee.

devon: Yes, POC T&M + optional reserved pricing; include credit for packaging hours and a PS line for HSM/integration. I'll draft numbers.

kai: Engineering caveat: if they want their on-disk encryption + custom KMS, that adds integration time. Also quantization can affect accuracyinclude a small eval check in acceptance.

nina: I'll prep the security attachment: SBOM, manifest, signing chain, telemetry statement, and patch SLA table (7 business days for critical with dependencies noted).

jord: Ops can commit to signed-delta delivery for CRITICAL CVEs within 7 business days if escalation & shipping are pre-agreed. Non-critical timelines longer (30 business days).

maria: Action items: @devon draft commercial with POC T&M + 3mo reserved option + packaging PS fee. @kai produce microbundle sample + size table. @nina write security attachment. @jord outline USB image courier process.

shipbot: deploy-bot: created ticket SVC-12109 "Airgap POC packaging & signing" assigned to eng-runtime.

devon: I'll attach the commercial draft EOD tomorrow. Include optional onsite 1-day demo as add-on.

kai: Uploading microbundle sample to drive (link shared).

nina: Starting security draft, looping Legal.

maria: Thanks everyone, I'll sync with customer. If you have anonymized SBOMs or manifests from prior deals paste them here.

devon: I'll upload an anonymized SBOM later today.
